meta.title: About Jillian | Licensed Esthetician in Idaho Falls
meta.description: Meet Jillian Easter, the licensed esthetician behind Rosemary Esthetics in Idaho Falls. Austin Kade Academy graduate, certified in lashes and brows.

hero.heading: Meet Jillian
hero.lead: Licensed esthetician, founder of Rosemary Esthetics, and firm believer that skincare should feel as good as it looks.

story.image_alt: Jillian Easter, licensed esthetician and owner of Rosemary Esthetics in Idaho Falls
story.heading: Why I started Rosemary Esthetics
story.para1: After struggling with my own skin and confidence, I discovered how much skincare can impact the way you feel. I started Rosemary Esthetics to help others feel beautiful, confident, and comfortable in their own skin.
story.para2: Every service is personalized to your skin and your goals. I believe skincare should be both results-driven and relaxing, so I focus on creating an experience that feels calming from the moment you walk in.
story.para3: I just love getting to know my clients. Some of my favorite conversations happen in the treatment room, and it's so rewarding to watch your confidence grow with each visit.
story.para4: When I'm not in the studio, I'm with family, outdoors, or spoiling my dachshund, Raydar.
